blindSummary: Rated the most protective tier in the July 2026 assessment: state/province-level non-discrimination covering gender identity, with shield and refuge protections enforceable against actions brought from other states/provinces; no state/province-specific negative finding beyond the shared federal layer (passport and travel-document policy, already priced into the country-wide figure).
